summary: FAIL: six findings fully resolved; L3 participant/map cleanup is repaired, but temporary login/char socket close failures are forgotten. Independently reproduced retry and PASS with a non-released temporary transport. Stop/escalate; no third automatic fix cycle.

logic_errors.description: Temporary login/char transports are owned only by the local context manager. Framing references are removed before the socket context exits. If transport close raises, no temporary transport or cleanup failure is retained on the BotClient. The ordinary connection failure is lock-delayed, but the harness sees sock/rx_thread both None, does not poison the budget, retries and can PASS. A cleanup exception can also replace the original handshake exception before connect sees it.
logic_errors.evidence: Actual _login_server and _char_server/_handshake_socket, FixtureClient.connect, connect_pair and run_limb were exercised offline with a context socket whose close raises OSError without marking release. After the first refused handshake, both framing dictionaries and tracked resources were empty and cleanup_errors was empty; a retry at synthetic t=130 after t=100 was allowed and the limb recorded PASS. This was reproduced independently for login and character transports.
logic_errors.acceptance_limit: Deterministic injected transport close failures; not a claim of an observed real OS descriptor leak or live game connection. The supported login/char cleanup path fails the same conservative non-releasing-close contract already enforced for map sockets.
logic_errors.why_in_scope: This is an existing supported handshake resource lifecycle, not an unimplemented packet family. It violates the requested no-retry/no-PASS-with-retained-resources criterion and the implementation claim that any cleanup failure poisons the budget.
logic_errors.escalation_frontier: STOP after cycle 2. Require operator/parent decision on explicit temporary-transport ownership and cleanup-failure propagation to the shared budget. Track close uncertainty/failure, retain transport/origin evidence, independently attempt all participant cleanup, and block retry/later limbs/PASS while release is unconfirmed. No source repair or third automatic fix cycle performed.
